edits.old: **M2-07 — Transport boundaries.** Exercise missing credentials, spoofed class/identity, invalid enums/types/JSON, excessive nesting/strings, unsupported versions, fragmented messages, binary application frames, and size-limit plus-one cases. Enforce assembled-message limits of 4,096 bytes inbound/8,192 outbound, depth eight, and the documented 30-message/second rate with burst ten. Fail boundedly without crashing the game or creating atoms from received text.
edits.new: **M2-07 — Transport boundaries.** Exercise missing credentials, spoofed class/identity, invalid enums/types/JSON, excessive nesting/strings, unsupported versions, fragmented messages, binary application frames, and size-limit plus-one cases. Fail boundedly without crashing the game or creating atoms from received text. Run the production Elixir validator and later the identical native/ESP-IDF C++ parser/validator sources against the unchanged golden examples plus independent raw-byte/schema-branch cases in JSON_VALIDATION.md. Cover decoded duplicate keys (including escaped aliases/extensions), malformed UTF-8/surrogates, trailing roots, null-vs-missing, pool failure, exact safe-integer min/max/plus-one, integral decimal/exponent spellings and fractional precision traps such as 9007199254740990.5. Accept permitted top-level/capability extensions while rejecting strict nested additions. Reuse command/status sequences with changed extension content and reject the changed decoded message; object order, equivalent escapes and mathematically equal numeric spellings retain identical decoded comparison. Compare arbitrary extension numbers exactly without floats or the integer-only durable codec. Check outputs against the independent Draft 2020-12 oracle with exact numeric handling; agreement between production validators alone is insufficient.
